summary.text: Mike Petersen is a Republican state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 2 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner.

paragraphs.text: Mike Petersen was born in Ogden, Utah.
According to Ballotpedia, he earned a B.S. in psychology and an M.Ed. in counseling psychology from Brigham Young University and a Ph.D. in instructional technology from Utah State University.
His career experience includes working as an instructional designer, as a consultant, and owning a business.

Petersen served on the Government Operations Committee, as vice chair in 2023-2024, and on the Public Utilities, Energy, and Technology Committee in the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 legislative terms, according to Ballotpedia.
His Republican primary on June 23, 2026 was canceled, and he advanced to the general election.
